'''Ess Al''' was a male [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] he and the other Trandoshans broke out and were recruited by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] to police and control other prisoners.<ref name="TORm1" />
